paragraphs: Attendance for construction sites, field crews and small businesses. Employees clock in from their phone with a location check, a selfie, and a QR code backup. Site supervisors mark whole crews in and out with one group photo, including workers who don't have a phone. Admins get a live attendance board, shift scheduling, site zones, monthly reports and a daily-wage sheet for payroll. Works in English, Hindi and Kannada. Many companies can use one deployment; each company only ever sees its own data.
Built with React + Vite (a web app that installs to the home screen) and Supabase (database, logins, photo storage).
